If you run out of the sample, you cannot perform any tests that use it but you can keep experimenting with other solutions in the Inventory from the previously performed tests. Comma-separated string of the cations present. Examples: 'K+, Sr+2, Al+3' or 'Li+, Hg2+2, Al+3, Ca+2, Cu+2'
